set.body:
Goal: legend a continuous color/fill scale with a colorbar. Continuous color SCALES already work (Palette.gradient at Scales.scala:423-433 plus ContinuousScale.train yields ContinuousScale[Rgba]); what is missing is any GUIDE for them.

Evidence: GuideSpec has only Axis and Legend (Layout.scala:134-165); guide derivation matches only DiscreteScale and silently drops continuous scales (CompilerPhases.scala:566-576, legendFor at :590-597). For scientific use (a t-map, a correlation field) a colorbar is table stakes.

Acceptance: a GuideSpec.Colorbar case (gradient swatch, tick breaks + labels from the scale transform, title); guide derivation emits a colorbar for a continuous color/fill scale and a discrete legend otherwise; solver reserves and places it like the legend strip; deterministic gradient sampling (byte-identical JVM/JS); conformance gains a colorbar case; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: continuous color guide (colorbar) and continuous-scale guide derivation
